acceptance_criteria: All 46 tests execute without migration errors
zig build test-xc01 through test-xc06 all PASS
No cascade failures blocking subsequent tests
task.description:
FINAL REWORK (2/2): Fix critical test infrastructure blocker. TestHarness.init() in tests/integration/helpers.zig has a broken migration system—it tries to re-apply migrations after clean_test_db.py truncates tables, but the schema_migrations tracking table causes idempotency failures. Only 4 of 46 tests passed before cascade failure.

Fix: Make migrations truly idempotent by either (a) detecting when migrations re-apply to truncated schema and handling gracefully, or (b) redesign test setup to run migrations once per suite instead of per-test.

Result: After fix, all 46 tests must pass. Verify with zig build test-xc01 through test-xc06.
